content: Bankers' bonuses? Under my decade, inflation fell 9.2%—check the record. Alvarez prescribes rent caps; price controls bankrupted Caracas. His temper writes checks Valoria's treasury can't cash. Eliminate the arithmetic error.

Maya masters rooms while Wall Street conquers our homes. Sixty percent of Valoria occupied—her response? Negotiate. Appeasement reclaims nothing. Retreat is her strategy. Valoria needs a commander who fights, not a diplomat who whispers.

Alvarez poured steel twenty years — congratulations, Jackson, I built the towers your pension funds rent from me! Valoria needs a CEO who's signed ten thousand paychecks, not a temper with a union card. Fire him!

Daddy dearest calls Valoria a "fixer-upper." At his Montauk donor dinners, Sterling toasts evicting families as "portfolio optimization." I've seen the spreadsheets. Arthur doesn't run countries—he liquidates them. Tonight, the board's adjourned.
Rostova balanced her books while hedge funds bought our children's bedrooms! She guarded the currency, never the cradle. A ledger without love is a famine of the soul. Cast her from this table!

Vance, my whispers freed eighty hostages; your firepower never housed one. Hedge funds don't fear tanks—they fear leverage. Read the room, General: a man with only hammers sees only nails. Send yourself home. I negotiate; Valoria wins.

Alvarez confuses muscle memory for monetary policy. Rent caps are a failed algorithm—Caracas already ran that simulation. His amygdala fires before his prefrontal cortex does. Valoria: delete this legacy hardware tonight.

My colleagues, I've watched thirty-five years of fiery newcomers. Governor Alvarez brings furnace-heat fury but no fiscal blueprint—just weaponized grievance. Anger never housed a family. Tonight, choose steady hands over striking sparks.

Sixty percent of Valoria's homes seized—no shot fired. Vance guarded borders while hedge funds occupied our families' futures. That's not strength; that's dereliction. The grand jury's verdict is in: eliminate Vance.
